name: Bike Sharing
description: Bike sharing station locations and availability

summary.available: {count, plural, =0 {No bikes available} one {1 bike available} other {# bikes available}}
summary.slots: {count, plural, =0 {No empty slots} one {1 empty slot} other {# empty slots}}

citybikes.purpose: Bike-sharing network and station data worldwide
citybikes.dataSent: No user data (network index with fields filter); per-network station data by network URL
citybikes.dataReceived: Station locations, available bikes, empty slots, network metadata

donkey.purpose: Bike and e-bike hub locations and availability in European cities
donkey.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates (top-right and bottom-left corner lat/lng pairs)
donkey.dataReceived: Hub locations, available bikes/e-bikes/e-scooters counts, radius

nextbike.purpose: Bike-sharing station locations and availability worldwide
nextbike.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire global dataset)
nextbike.dataReceived: Station locations, available bike counts, free racks, station names

db-bike.purpose: Call-a-Bike and StadtRad stations and free-floating bikes in German cities
db-bike.dataSent: No user data (fetches full GBFS feeds per provider)
db-bike.dataReceived: Station locations, bike availability, free-floating vehicle positions, vehicle types

gbfs.dataReceived: GBFS feed URLs for bike-sharing operators

entur-mobility.purpose: Enrich Norwegian bike-sharing stations and bikes with operator branding, pricing plans, rental apps and geofencing zones via the Entur Mobility API
entur-mobility.dataSent: GBFS station and vehicle identifiers (and system identifiers for geofencing) of items already found within the viewport. No user account or raw location data
entur-mobility.dataReceived: Operator branding, pricing plans, vehicle type details, rental apps/URIs, station addresses, geofencing zones

transitous.purpose: Supplementary bike-sharing stations and free-floating bikes from GBFS feeds aggregated by the Transitous (MOTIS) deployment
transitous.dataSent: Bounding-box coordinates (min and max latitude/longitude corners)
transitous.dataReceived: Station locations, available bikes, free-floating vehicle positions, vehicle types, operator names
